metadata.datasource: Traced off the bitmaps of HARMAN technology, 'New MGRC vs MGIVRC' technical information (Mar 2020): MULTIGRADE RC DELUXE (new) through filter grade 1, MULTIGRADE developer 1+9, 1 min at 20 C; spectral sensitivity read as relative log sensitivity, peak 1.0, level set so the paper sees as much of the enlarger lamp as Kodak Portra Endura does through its neutral filtration. Base 0.056; mid-grey (18% reflectance) at log E 0. One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
